role_in_thesis: local dense urban proof-of-concept / earlier experiment
target_description: Spatially concentrated Amsterdam BRO well subset under the source-compatible modelling window
main_scientific_message: The local dense case showed that transfer can help but fixed transfer still harms a substantial minority of wells; selective policies are useful as transfer-risk controls in a compact urban panel.

role_in_thesis: final larger-scale evaluation / generalizability and transfer heterogeneity test
target_description: National source-compatible Netherlands BRO target panel under the 1996-2016 modelling constraints
main_scientific_message: The national extension tests whether the framework generalizes beyond the local case and shows that transfer heterogeneity persists at larger scale; similarity helps as one selector input but does not determine transfer success by itself.
